prompt: Hibernate Envers revision number overflow negative exception type
answer:
The exception type is:

```text
org.hibernate.envers.exception.AuditException
```

with the message:

```text
Negative revision numbers are not allowed
```

Hibernate Envers throws it when the generated revision number is negative, as shown in `DefaultRevisionInfoGenerator.saveRevisionData()`.
